search_notes: CCTG IND.227 / KEYNOTE-483. Merck and CCTG topline release of 10 Mar 2023: met OS at final analysis, no numbers; the Merck page for that release was not found (404), so the row cites same-day OncLive coverage that quotes it (TargetedOnc 13 Mar and Medthority 11 Mar give the same release date). HR 0.79 (0.64-0.98), two-sided p=0.0324, in the Merck release of 3 Jun 2023 for ASCO LBA8505; Lancet paper 3 Nov 2023 (PMID 37931632). Registry also lists the phase 2 PFS as a primary outcome (phase 2 part published Feb 2023, PMID 36841541); this row is the phase 3 OS. Registry primary completion (2024-10-11) is 19 months after the topline.

Junshi JS001-CT25-III-NSCLC (toripalimab + pemetrexed-platinum after EGFR-TKI failure; lead sponsor is a company). Registry shows completed, primary completion 2024-10-21, last update 2026-08-06, no results posted. No result found by NCT, study number, toripalimab + EGFR-TKI in English or Chinese web searches, PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref; only the phase 2 (PMID 34650034) is published, and a June 2026 review (PMID 42317338) still cites only that. Junshi's pipeline page lists no EGFR-TKI-failed indication and its 2026 interim results summary does not mention the trial. The full 2025 annual report and 2026 interim report (HKEX/SSE) were not opened, so a one-line mention there is possible.

CLOVER (4 vs 6 cycles of adjuvant TC). No result found by NCT, acronym or design in a web search, PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref. Registry status unknown, last updated Nov 2023, enrolment still an estimate (2,172). No Chinese-language search was run. A cycle-number comparison of this kind is usually a non-inferiority design; not checked.

Tongji Hospital adjuvant sintilimab + lenvatinib in HCC with PVTT. Registry still not yet recruiting, last updated Oct 2023; the estimated primary completion (2024-11) predates any plausible follow-up for 104 patients. Reviews of 2025-2026 cite it only as a registered trial. Web search budget ran out before this row: checked only the registry record, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref (registry number and design keywords); no general web or Chinese-language search was run.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR in PD-L1-positive population
search_notes: TORCHLIGHT (lead sponsor is a company). Junshi press release dated 20 Feb 2023 Beijing time (Chinese, PDF opened; OncLive coverage 21 Feb): IDMC judged the primary endpoint to have crossed the efficacy boundary at the prespecified interim analysis, PFS significantly longer in PD-L1-positive patients, no numbers. A same-day HKEX/SSE notice probably exists but was not opened. HR first shown at ASCO 2023 LBA1013; the coverage opened is dated 4 Jun 2023 and the exact session day was not confirmed (abstract DOI deposited 7 Jun). Registry lists two primaries: ITT PFS was HR 0.77 (0.602-0.994), nominal p=0.0445, and whether that crossed the interim boundary was not verified; met is recorded on the PD-L1-positive primary. Nature Medicine paper Jan 2024. Registry primary completion (2024-12-31) is 22 months after the readout.

NItCHE-MITO33. No result found by NCT, acronym, MITO 33 or drug names in two web searches, PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref; only the design paper (PMID 34607820) and trial-in-progress abstracts exist. The MITO study dashboard (opened Oct 2026) lists it as active, enrolment closed. Registry status unknown, not updated since Aug 2021. ESMO 2026 (23-27 Oct) programme was not checked.

which_endpoint: OS after second randomisation (cetuximab re-challenge vs physician choice)
search_notes: FIRE-4 (AIO KRK-0114), ASCO 2025 abstract 3513: OS 17.6 vs 15.1 months, HR 0.84, p=0.48, no CI given; 'FIRE-4 did not meet its primary endpoint'. Abstract text read through the Crossref record of the DOI (ASCO pages do not load for scripts) and dated by its deposit, 28 May 2025; ASCO normally puts regular abstracts online about a week earlier, so the true date is probably a few days before. Only 87 of 672 randomised patients reached the second randomisation, so the comparison is underpowered. The first randomisation (switch maintenance, a secondary question) was reported at ASCO 2022, seen in a search summary only. OncoDaily coverage 1 Jun 2025. No paper of the primary analysis in PubMed yet.

FANTASTIC (Sun Yat-sen, adjuvant mFOLFOXIRI vs mFOLFOX6). Registry status unknown, last updated Dec 2023; no publication or abstract found. Beware namesakes: a Japanese phase 2 also called FANTASTIC (mFOLFOXIRI after metastasectomy, PMID 39086881) and a Sun Yat-sen MRD-positive mFOLFOXIRI vs mFOLFOX6 trial-in-progress abstract (ASCO 2024 TPS3642) that may be a different record. Web search budget ran out before this row: checked only the registry record, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref (registry number and design keywords); no general web or Chinese-language search was run.

which_endpoint: EFS, first randomisation (PAXG vs mFOLFIRINOX); the second-randomisation EFS (long vs short course) was not met
search_notes: PACT-21 CASSANDRA, ASCO 2025 LBA4004: EFS HR 0.64 (0.48-0.86), p=0.003 for PAXG vs mFOLFIRINOX. Coverage opened is dated 1 Jun 2025 (OncLive, TargetedOnc); the ASCO Daily News item (DOI 10.1200/adn.25.300183, page blocked) is dated 31 May per Crossref, so the presentation was probably 31 May. Lancet paper 20 Nov 2025 gives HR 0.63 (0.47-0.84) (PMID 41275879). 2x2 FACTORIAL with two registry primaries: the second randomisation (long vs short preoperative course) showed no EFS difference, HR 0.98 (0.68-1.41), published 5 Sep 2026 (PMID 42733563); an earlier congress presentation of that part was not looked for. Recorded met on the first randomisation; 'mixed' is arguable.

JS004-009-III-cHL (tifcemalimab + toripalimab; lead sponsor is a company). Registry recruiting, last updated Feb 2025, study completion 2027-09. No result found by NCT, study number or drug names in a web search, PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref; only the phase 1 is published (PMID 40379637). Junshi's pipeline page shows tifcemalimab in phase 3 and its 2026 interim results summary reports no readout. The 2025-05 estimated primary completion looks stale.

DREAM3R, ESMO 2025 LBA104 (Annals of Oncology DOI 10.1016/j.annonc.2025.09.121): median OS 21 vs 18 months, HR 0.92 (0.63-1.36), p=0.9. Coverage opened is dated 19 Oct 2025; the session day within the congress (17-21 Oct) was not confirmed. Accrual stopped early (214 of 480 planned; 174 in the chemotherapy-control cohort analysed) after nivolumab-ipilimumab became standard, so the trial is underpowered and the presenters called it inconclusive; a primary analysis was nonetheless reported, hence not_met rather than terminated. Registry results posted 2026-10-01 with the same medians. No paper in PubMed yet.

Registry: terminated for 'insufficient patient accrual' with 8 patients enrolled (primary completion 2025-07-02, last update 2026-05-29). No primary analysis is possible; no abstract or paper found in PubMed or Europe PMC. Sponsor-investigator trial with Novartis support.

St. James's Hospital TNT vs neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in T3 rectal cancer, 100 patients. Registry still not yet recruiting, last updated Oct 2023; no publication found. Web search budget ran out before this row: checked only the registry record, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref (registry number and design keywords); no general web or Chinese-language search was run.

GLMU-08 (induction GP then IMRT alone vs concurrent chemoradiotherapy in nasopharyngeal carcinoma; likely a non-inferiority design, not checked). Registry recruiting, last updated May 2023; no publication found. Beware a sibling from the same Guilin group: NCT02434614 (TPF induction then RT vs CCRT) was published in JAMA Oncology in 2024 (PMID 38329737) and is a different trial. Web search budget ran out before this row: checked only the registry record, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref (registry number and design keywords); no general web or Chinese-language search was run.

EFFIPEC (Uppsala, phase I then registry-based phase III). Registry recruiting, last updated May 2025. PubMed shows only the protocol (PMID 38437211) and the single-arm phase I dose-escalation part, published in BJS Open on 4 Sep 2026 (PMID 42832193; no abstract in PubMed and the full text did not load); no phase III recurrence-free survival result found. Web search budget ran out before this row: checked only the registry record, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref (registry number and design keywords); no general web or Chinese-language search was run.

Pola-R-ICE (GLA 2017-R2), EHA 2026 oral S237 (abstract EHA-3674), presented by B. Glass: 2-year EFS 26% vs 30%, p=0.901, no improvement in EFS, PFS or OS. Earliest source opened is coverage dated 11 Jun 2026, the first congress day; EHA abstracts normally go online some weeks before the congress and the abstract page itself was not found, so the true first date is probably earlier. The only EFS hazard ratio seen is HR 1.0 (p=0.901) from a multivariable analysis, no CI, in coverage dated 12 Jun; it was probably in the abstract too. No Roche or GLA release found; registry updated 2026-06-10 without results. No paper in PubMed.

Fudan QYHJ (Qingyi Huaji) formula vs placebo with chemotherapy in metastatic pancreatic cancer. Registry completed (primary completion 2025-12-30), last updated 2026-09-03, no results posted. No result found by NCT, formula name or design in a web search (English and Chinese terms), PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref; only preclinical QYHJ papers appear. CNKI and CSCO abstracts were not searched.

Web search budget ran out before this row: checked only the registry record, PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref (registry number and design keywords); no general web or Chinese-language search was run.

Shandong PCI vs MRI surveillance in limited-stage SCLC (non-inferiority on OS). The trial protocol was published in Respiratory Research on 8 Sep 2026 (PMID 42763407) and describes the trial prospectively, with no results. Registry recruiting, not updated since Apr 2021. No abstract found in PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref. The web search budget ran out before a general web search on this row.

SY-3505 (ficonalkib) vs crizotinib (lead sponsor is a company, SSE 688197). Shouyao's reply to an SSE inquiry on its 2025 annual report, printed 6 Jun 2026 (https://paper.cnstock.com/html/2026-06/06/content_2228278.htm): phase 3 enrolment completed in H1 2025, follow-up continuing, interim analysis is triggered at 75% of PFS events and has not happened, another 1-2 years of follow-up expected, NDA assumed 2027. Registry still says not yet recruiting (last update Feb 2024). Nothing after June 2026 was checked.

ALPHABET (GEICAM/2017-01). INFERRED, no sponsor statement found: the design paper planned about 300 patients (PMID 35465733), the registry shows 27 actually enrolled and active, not recruiting (last update Sep 2025), and the EU CTIS record (2024-514611-98-00) lists the trial as ended on 23 Dec 2025 with 27 participants and no results. With 27 patients across two cohorts the event-driven PFS analysis cannot be run. No abstract or paper found by NCT, acronym or drug names in a web search, PubMed, Europe PMC or Crossref; the reason for stopping accrual is not stated in any source opened. A descriptive report may still appear.

IFM2017-03, ASH 2024 abstract 774 (opened and read): median PFS 48.5 vs 21.5 months, HR 0.51 (0.37-0.71), p<0.0001, at 40 months median follow-up. Dated 5 Nov 2024, the publication date of the Blood supplement abstract in Crossref (DOI 10.1182/blood-2024-203045) and the day ASH abstracts went online; the programme page itself carries only the oral date, 9 Dec 2024, where the update was HR 0.51 (0.37-0.70). Lancet Oncology paper Oct 2025 (PMID 41038184). An ASH 2022 abstract reported 12-month response and safety only, not PFS. Registry primary completion (2026-08-28, actual) is 22 months after the disclosure, so the lag is strongly negative.
